svg.title: @maeul-sky · Civilization · Sample
svg.desc: Isometric contribution terrain for @maeul-sky from 2025-01-05 to 2026-01-03. 1,582 contributions across 269 active days. 3 wonders discovered. relative normalization, maximum 11.

g.aria-label: Contribution height legend. Relative scale from 0 to 11 contributions. Five increasing bars represent terrain height. Terrain colors follow the seasons.

rect.aria-label: Empty contribution height; representative elevation 0 of 99
Low contribution height; representative elevation 20 of 99
Mid contribution height; representative elevation 45 of 99
High contribution height; representative elevation 70 of 99
Max contribution height; representative elevation 99 of 99

g.aria-label: Calendar timeline from 2025-01-05 to 2026-01-03. Month and season cues follow supplied contribution dates.
